stagePolicyDigest.description: Canonical SHA256 of the stage's run-checkpoint-policy.v2 at claim.

source.description: `card`: the card named them. `default`: the stage's defaultRepositories. `single`: the allowlist has one repository.

repositories.description: The chosen names, sorted, unique; exactly the narrowed policy's repository names.

checkpointRepository.description: One of `repositories`; equal to the narrowed policy's checkpointRepository.

title: PROPOSED frozen repository selection of a checkpoint claim
description: Recorded with the claim beside the narrowed checkpoint-policy.v1 the claim carries. A consumer recomputes the narrowing from the stage policy and refuses any difference.
